name: io.github.pioootrek/worktree-control
title: Worktree Control
description: Claim and switch dev servers between Git worktrees on stable ports, queue tests, keep project memory

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Installation token or scoped agent token. Run `worktree-control auth token generate` before the first client-launched start; `worktree-control config mcp` prints the header. Open mode needs no header.

token.description: Worktree Control installation token or scoped agent token

packageArguments.description: Run the local controller in the foreground

packageArguments.name: --no-open
packageArguments.description: Do not open the dashboard in a browser when the client starts the controller

packageArguments.name: --host
packageArguments.description: Dashboard bind address, fixed to loopback. Without it the controller listens on 0.0.0.0. MCP always listens on loopback.

packageArguments.name: --mcp-port
packageArguments.description: Loopback port for the MCP endpoint
